title: Will gold’s ‘infinite mint bug’ make Bitcoin more valuable?
summary: A US fusion startup says it has turned mercury into gold. Could a potential increase in the gold supply strengthen Bitcoin’s claim to be a better form of digital gold?

title: Live updates: Binance says $6.34B set aside to cover hack losses
summary: Follow live updates as Binance says $6.3 billion in assets have been stolen in a major hack. Around $3 billion in stolen funds have been frozen.

title: Binance working with FBI to recover assets following $6.3B hack
summary: Binance is working with law enforcement to recover $3 billion that is frozen, after setting aside more than $6.3 billion from the company’s funds to cover the shortfall.

title: Binance says it holds $5B in matching tokens to cover hack losses
summary: The exchange said it set aside more than $6.34 billion to cover losses and would include the assets in its next proof-of-reserves report.

title: Zcash grants group offers $124M compromise as governance backlash grows
summary: Zcash Community Grants proposed redirecting about $124 million in existing and future funding toward mining rewards, but critics say the plan fails to address governance and accountability concerns.

title: Bitcoin price metrics hint at rebound as $1.6B liquidations follow Binance hack
summary: Bitcoin held above $76,000 after a $6.3 billion Binance hack and a tech-stock sell-off, as momentum indicators pointed to a possible rebound.

title: EIP-7702 didn’t cause Binance hack, but may have amplified losses
summary: Security experts say attackers could have drained Binance’s wallets without EIP-7702, but the Ethereum upgrade may have helped bypass withdrawal safeguards.

title: Binance hacker’s Bitcoin haul tops Coinbase’s corporate treasury
summary: The attackers held 18,270 BTC early Friday, topping Coinbase’s reported corporate holdings, and an Ether stash exceeding 500,000 ETH.

title: THORChain’s RUNE jumps 13% after Binance’s record $6.3B hack
summary: North Korean hackers previously used THORChain to move funds stolen from Bybit and Bitget, prompting calls for the protocol to intervene.

title: Trezor warns CryptoBilis buyers to move funds over suspected implant
summary: Trezor urged customers who bought devices from CryptoBilis since March to move their funds after a report of a suspected hardware implant.
